Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

What's new

  • Translate. Messages in a language you don't read now show a Translate button. The translation happens on your Mac, so nothing is sent anywhere. Quoted earlier messages are left out, and Show Original switches back. The first time you translate from a language, macOS may ask to download it.
  • Reply from the notch. New mail at the notch now has a reply button. Type, press Return, and it's sent with the usual few seconds to undo. Escape cancels.

Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

Improvements

  • New mail at the notch now slides away after 4 seconds instead of 6. It still stays while your pointer is over it.

Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

What's new

  • New mail at the notch (experimental). Turn on Show new mail at the notch in Settings › General › Notifications. New mail then drops down from the top of the screen instead of showing as a macOS notification. It shows the sender, subject and a preview, and any sign-in code is one click to copy. Click the message to open it. It slides away after a few seconds, or stays while your pointer is over it. Use Try It to see a sample.
